metaDescription: Kevin criticizes the US-Israel Futures Act and NDAA section 219, urges viewers to contact Congress via govspeak.us, and cites Thomas Massie's warning.
summary: Kevin argues that the United States Israel Futures Act, included in the FY2027 NDAA as section 219 (earlier numbered 224), would erode American sovereignty by merging US and Israeli military technology cooperation. He describes the bill's sponsors, Senators Ted Budd and Kirsten Gillibrand and Representative Ronny Jackson, and reports Thomas Massie's warning that the House voted on a rule that blocked debate on striking the section. Kevin urges viewers to contact their representatives through govspeak.us and to use public pressure, as with Flock camera backlash. He also criticizes the lack of a debate vote and discusses limits of boycotts.
